name: 楊哲化
objective:
先修課程：3001011 或負責教授同意。介紹結構體在受到張力、壓力、剪力、扭力及彎曲等外力狀態下之變形，分析應力、應變及變形，莫耳圓、壓力容器、樑、柱。
Prerequisite: ME111 or Consent of Instructor
Introduction of the deformation, strain and stress of structures (Beam, Column, Pressure vessel) under several different loading conditions such as Tension, Compression, Shear force, Torsion and Bending moment.
課程進度(1-16週):
1	9/9	Introduction to Mechanics of Materials
2	9/16	Chap. 1 Stress
3	9/23	Chap. 2 Strain
4	9/30	Chap. 3 Material properties
5	10/7	Chap. 3 Material properties                       
6	10/14	Chap. 4.1~4.4 Axial loading                      Quiz 1
7	10/21	Chap. 4.5~4.8 Axial loading                       
8	10/28	Chap. 5 Torsion
9	11/4	Midterm Exam
10	11/11	Chap. 6 Bending
11	11/18	Chap. 6 Bending
12	11/25	Chap. 7 Transverse shear
13	12/2	Chap. 8 Combined loading                        
14	12/9	Chap. 8 Combined loading                        Quiz 2
15	12/16	Chap. 9 Stress transformation
16	12/23	Chap. 12 Deflection of beams
17	12/30	Chap. 13 Buckling
18	1/6	Final Exam
